segments.text: Upload a tutorial and watch it play. Replay Lab turns its instructions into a checkpoint you can practice.
Meta Llama generates a checkpoint from the tutorial's transcript and sampled frame. Review the result, then approve it.
Now follow the tutorial in the shared Code Lab tab. Replay Lab reads the actual screen and checks its visible heading against the approved checkpoint.
Pass. The screen matches the tutorial, and the graph marks the checkpoint complete.
